page_title: WER 2-1 HOL | Werder Bremen v Holstein Kiel 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+4' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the crossbar and is cleared to safety.
90+2' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) receives a yellow card.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 2 - 1 Goal! Keke Topp picks out Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom right corner with a header from close range. 2:1.
88' Here comes a substitution. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Derrick Kohn.
88' Holstein Kiel concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. It's a free kick to Werder Bremen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

86' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Soren Storks no option but to blow his whistle. Holstein Kiel are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) is replacing Phil Harres.
83' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Holstein Kiel.
81' Some neat passing and movement from Werder Bremen as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
80' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
78' Substitution. Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) on for Marvin Ducksch.
78' Substitution. Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) in, Marco Friedl out.
75' The Holstein Kiel players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
72' Marcel Rapp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) replacing Steven Skrzybski.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tymoteusz Puchacz leaves the pitch and Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) comes on.
71' A clumsy foul by Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel) and Soren Storks blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Werder Bremen.
69' What a wasted opportunity by Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Michael Zetterer makes a decent save to thwart him.
68' Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Soren Storks had an easy-decision to make.
66' Here is a change. Justin Njinmah is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).

66' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
65' The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
64' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
62' Armin Gigovic will be replaced by Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel).
60' One of the Werder Bremen players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Free kick. Holstein Kiel will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
59' Werder Bremen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
55' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Werder Bremen get a corner.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Soren Storks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' What a beauty from just outside the box! Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
46' The corner is swung in but Holstein Kiel can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Ole Werner probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Jens Stage (Werder Bremen). He is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Werder Bremen will take a free kick near the side line. Soren Storks blows the whistle, Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) is penalised for a foul.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Holstein Kiel have a free kick.
44' A free kick has been awarded to Werder Bremen.
40' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Werder Bremen due to a handball in the build-up play.
40' Wait! Referee Soren Storks has indicated he is going to review the Werder Bremen goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
39' Goal! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the back of the net.

36' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Timon Weiner just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
33' The ball goes behind for a corner. Holstein Kiel will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' Holstein Kiel take a short corner kick.
30' The foul by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) was seen by Soren Storks who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Holstein Kiel are awarded a free kick.
30' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) picks up a yellow card.
28' Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Werder Bremen earn a free kick.
28' The linesman makes the right call and Werder Bremen will have a corner.
26' Holstein Kiel are ruled offside.
25' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Soren Storks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
23' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes a short corner kick.

17' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
12' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

12' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Timon Weiner shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
9' Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Werder Bremen.
7' Soren Storks blows his whistle and signals a foul after Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) brought his opponent down. Holstein Kiel will take a free kick.
5' A cross into the box picks out Jens Stage (Werder Bremen), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
Soren Storks got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
